svg.title: ZmalaCall Nano keypad wiring
svg.desc: Four normally-open switches on D2 to D5, and four LEDs controlled by MOSFET drivers on D6 to D9. USB supplies serial data and power. All grounds connect to Nano GND.

g.text: Classic 5 V Arduino Nano / ATmega328P · four arcade switches + four LEDs
Logical net labels: connect D2–D9 to the matching Nano pins. All GND symbols are the same connection.
D0 / D1 reserved for USB serial
COMMON GND · Nano GND, all switch COM terminals, all gate pull-downs and MOSFET sources
Q1–Q4: logic-level N-channel MOSFETs, suitable at 5 V gate drive. Check the chosen part’s D / G / S pinout.
Lamp modules must include 5 V current limiting. Keep LED and switch terminals separate. Total USB load ≤ 150 mA.
No Pi GPIO connection or external supply. GPIO pins drive gates only, never the lamps directly.
